behavior: Injectable clock/tick scheduler makes reviews due at 60-second boundaries without a lifetime cap.
Busy transport, unsafe worker session state, and user priority retain only the newest due review and report delayed/coalesced state.
Pause continues non-model collection and retains one pending review; cancel, unapproved, unhealthy, or invalid authority clears pending work fail-closed.
Worker readiness enforces exact session generation and strict integer inFlightToolCount typing.
Only confirmed exits surface once; review facts are allowlisted and model text is never retained.
Hang classification requires explicit process and running-lifecycle evidence; elapsed silence is informational only.
Usage accounting separates observed, estimated, and unknown values without a fixed count cap.

CW-10 active run/session/exit represented through injected narrow callables
Periodic review delivery supplied by the existing public TaskMailbox adapter; no workflow or bridge implementation changed
